_note: Overrides for app/services/market_horizon.DEFAULT_CONFIG. Weights need not sum to one; each axis normalises its own. An optional input is used for every vendor that has it and does not keep a vendor off the map.

headcount_pct._why: Needs two profile readings inside the window. Profile collection on AI in the SOC began 19 August 2026 and polls weekly, so requiring it left one vendor on the map. Optional until the second readings exist; it counts wherever present.
